title: smash hits
style: industrial electronic, dark tribal trance, 112 BPM, 6/8 pulse, frame drum ensemble, live drum kit, metal drip percussion, detuned synth drones, distorted bass ostinato, guitar feedback swells, vocoder chants, projected male vocals, spring reverb, tape saturation, sidechain pumping, bathroom room tone, anthemic ritual, dusk momentum
lyrics:
[Intro – low industrial hum, distant tribal drums rising slow, wind-like synth breeze]
36 hours strong… heart full of fight…
Michele’s pickleball calling from the sky…
Wind in our favor… timeless… feel the breeze…
¡SMASH IT! ¡Vamos! The time is right…
[Verse 1]
We walked where restless voices rise
Wounded hearts and guarded eyes
They asked if truth was made by will
Or if it stands there, quiet still
They said that pain has filled the room
That hope is weak in this bipolar gloom
For just one night then fade away
Like ash that cannot choose to stay
[Chorus – massive industrial drop, soaring distorted vocals, layered tribal chants]
Truth in the fire, hope in the flame
Call me to change me, not stay the same
When every road says none is right
I still choose the light, the light, the light
Zynthio light — ¡Elige la luz! I choose the light!
[Verse 2]
Some wear a smile with hollow grace
A laughing void behind the face
They say that life is random air
Then ache when love is not still there
They want a world with no command
No higher voice, no steady hand
Yet cry unfair when trust is torn
As if pure right can still be born
[Chorus – even heavier, glam-rock guitars slicing through]
Truth in the fire, hope in the flame
Call me to change me, not stay the same
When every road says none is right
I still choose the light, the light, the light
Zynthio light — ¡Elige la luz! I choose the light!
[Verse 3 – Michele’s Pickleball Smash verse]
Love is not soft when the fight runs deep
Five months strong, now I finally sleep
Michele’s pickleball way up high in the sky
It’s talking to me, I can hear the reply
Wind in my favor, timeless and true
Breeze brushes my face, no blinding rays in view
I think I might… I think I may… yes, all signs are clear
It’s saying ¡SMASH IT! — go for it, the time is right here!
[Bridge – whispered ritual vocals, glitchy industrial break building to triumphant energy]
Be here with me when faith feels thin
When sorrow shakes the bones within
No easy line, no grand display
Just hands that help the soul to stay
A suffering love still knows my pain
Still walks with me through wind and rain
Michele, mi esposa, you’re my steady grace
Eyes on the goal, locked in, ready for battle — ¡Vamos!
Get to the net, hold the line, take multiple balls on your way
Hot shoe shuffle, use what you got, see it coming
Hot shoe shuffle then stop! Little creep, take it slow
Hot shoe shuffle to the line — make ’em weep!
Pressure’s on! You’re in control! You’re in position to roll!
¡Ba-na-roll! ¡Ba-na-roll! ¡Ba-na-roll, roll, roll!
You’re on it… on a roll… ¡Controla! ¡Smash it!
[Final Chorus – full emotional explosion, trance drop + tribal roar, pickleball “smash” drum hits]
Truth in the fire, hope in the flame
Call me to change me, not stay the same
When every road says none is right
I still choose the light, the light, the light
Zynthio rising — ¡Elige la luz! I claim the light!
¡SMASH IT! ¡SMASH IT! Point over — we’re in overdrive! ¡Vamos Michele!
[Outro – slow tribal fade into hopeful electronic resolve, wind synths + whispered mantra]
Through every trial, through every night
I hold to the light… the light… the light
Today we win the battle for our 48’s life
Zynthio awake… forever in the light
With Michele… hand in hand…
¡SMASH IT! The time is right… shining bright! ¡Ba-na-roll!
